messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx + streaming disconnect rate detected on /v1/stream (ingress-gateway). Spike started ~1746001200. Current 5xx rate 9.8% (baseline 0.6%). Streaming disconnects up ~12x. Paging on-call: @Sophia (oncall). Link: https://dash/redwood/incidents/1746001234

Sophia: on it, taking pager. I see the alert. Starting triage — who can grab LB/gateway logs and recent deploys?

Raj: I can pull gateway logs and lb metrics. Checking envoy upstream health now. Any suspect deploys? deploy-bot, did anything go out near 1746001100-1746001200?

deploy-bot: Deploy: roll/ingress-proxy v2.12.1 -> v2.12.2 at 1746001087 by elena. Canary passed on 10% for 5m.

Elena: I rolled a small patch to chunked-encoding handling for keepalive; can revert if needed. I didn't expect client-side cancel behavior to change.

Sophia: ok could be related to chunked encoding changes. Raj, grab envoy logs for 502/504/stream disconnects. Matt, can you check stream worker queues and backpressure?

Matt: looking at stream-worker-03 logs. Seeing a lot of "upstream reset" and "client canceled" entries. Example: 
```
[2025-11-02T12:07:45Z] stream-worker-03 ERROR upstream reset: connection reset by peer id=abc123 path=/v1/stream
[2025-11-02T12:07:46Z] stream-worker-03 WARN kv-cache miss spike 7x
```

Raj: envoy logs from ingress-proxy-2 show repeated 502s with "upstream connect error or disconnect" and long TCP handshake times. Pasted snippet: 
```
[2025-11-02T12:08:02Z] envoy ERROR cluster upstream connect failure: connection reset by peer
[2025-11-02T12:08:05Z] envoy WARN downstream closed before response complete (chunked)
```

CS Ops: CS reporting customer-side timeouts and partial streams. Top affected tenants: AcmeCorp, NovaFin, Chatly. We're starting outreach — severity P1.

Sophia: mitigation plan — short term: 1) revert ingress-proxy chunked-encoding change to v2.12.1 2) toggle graceful-fallback so streaming routes fall back to non-streaming endpoint for timeouts 3) increase gateway keepalive and proxy read timeout from 45s -> 90s 4) enable additional logging on stream-workers for client-cancel reasons.

Elena: I can revert the commit. Reverting to v2.12.1 now for ingress-proxy canary at 10%. Rolling command: 
```
kubectl -n infra set image deploy/ingress-proxy ingress-proxy=registry/redwood/ingress-proxy:v2.12.1 --record
```

Matt: while canary runs, I'll flip fallback on the route. Command (console API): 
```
POST /api/v1/route-configs/stream/fallback -d '{"fallback_to":"/v1/generative-sync","enabled":true}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN"
```

Sophia: doing a quick impact check — metrics show 60% drop in 5xx on canary hosts within 3m. Streaming disconnect rate on canary down to baseline. Pushing full rollback if stable for 5m.

Raj: confirming LB backend health returned to normal after canary rollback. No new connection resets in last 4m. I'm keeping tcp dumps on for problematic VIPs.

CS Ops: Notifying account teams for AcmeCorp and Chatly: temporary fallback enabled, customers may see non-stream responses for a short window. Suggested message drafted: "We're mitigating intermittent streaming disconnects by routing to a stable non-stream endpoint; minimal functionality preserved while we restore streaming."

Sophia: full rollback started at 1746001500. Monitoring. If any customer reports degradation, escalate to eng-sre.

Elena: rollback complete across all ingress-proxy replicas at 1746001567. Confirming no new 502s on ingress proxies.

Matt: Stream worker queue depth normalized. Sample logs after rollback: 
```
[2025-11-02T12:14:20Z] stream-worker-03 INFO stream session established id=def456
[2025-11-02T12:15:05Z] stream-worker-03 INFO kv-cache hit rate stable
```

Raj: keepalives and read timeout increased on all front-proxies as precaution. No regressions seen.

CS Ops: Customer updates sent. AcmeCorp requested a post-incident call — scheduled.

Sophia: marking incident mitigated at 1746001800 — error rates back to baseline, streaming disconnects under threshold. Next actions: postmortem, root cause: buggy chunked-encoding edge case in v2.12.2 causing upstream resets under certain client cancellation patterns; action items: revert patch (done), add unit/integration tests for chunked boundary cases, add canary traffic profile that simulates client cancellations.

Raj: I'll hold tcp captures and heaps for 24h in case of recurrence.

Elena: will open PR with tests and more defensive parsing; schedule a careful canary with expanded test profile.

Matt: leaving additional dashboards up for 48h and will alert if any drift.

Sophia: handing off to Raj for follow-up on monitoring retention and root cause verification. Raj, you're the owner for postmortem — assigning to you. :white_check_mark:

Raj: accepted. I will produce postmortem draft by EOD and include timeline and mitigation steps.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: mitigation confirmed. Summary: rollback of ingress-proxy v2.12.2, fallback to sync endpoint, increased timeouts. Postmortem owner: Raj. Links: https://dash/redwood/incidents/1746001234/postmortem
